judgement_methodology.sampling_strategy: Evenly spaced frames between 10% and 90% of clip duration.
judgement_methodology.full_body_visible: MediaPipe PoseLandmarker (full) run on each sampled frame. A frame passes if all 8 key lower/upper body landmarks (shoulders 11/12, hips 23/24, knees 25/26, ankles 27/28) have visibility >= 0.5 and normalized coords in [-0.02, 1.02]. Clip is marked full_body_visible=True if >= 60% of sampled frames pass.
judgement_methodology.hands_mudra_ready: MediaPipe HandLandmarker (num_hands=1, min_hand_detection_confidence=0.3) run on pose-guided wrist crops (box = max(160, 0.65 * torso_px) centered between wrist and index MCP) for each sampled frame, because full-frame detection misses ~45 px hands in 1080p video. Clip is marked hands_mudra_ready=True if >= 1 hand is detected in >= 50% of sampled frames AND median detected hand bounding box max(w, h) >= 40.0 px.

song_sequences.conclusion: No full song-to-dance sequences exist in the dataset. All 162 videos are individual adavu demonstration/practice clips (each showing one adavu category or variation), with no paired full-song choreography sequences or sequence annotations.
